units.source_text: 从嵌在窗框里的灰色天空中，飘进来纷纷扬扬的大雪花。

en.t: Large snowflakes drifted in from the gray sky set within the window frame.

units.source_text: 不知为什么，寂静得使人难以置信。

en.t: For some reason, the stillness was almost impossible to believe.

units.source_text: 岛村睡眠不足，茫然地望着虚空。

en.t: Short on sleep, Shimamura stared blankly into empty space.
